Short technical note —

I ran a quick baseline using our staging pack with redwood/gpt-neox-xxl-1 (int8 qkv shim). For an 8k average document and a KV cache optimized for prefix reuse, expect ~42GB peak host-side memory for a single model replica (includes overhead for batch of 4). With the planned Dedicated pool (2 replicas initially), we'll need to confirm a memory-optimized node class or increase replica sizing.

Risks / mitigation:
- Risk: If production docs average >12k, memory grows non-linearly. Mitigation: implement aggressive prefix trimming + per-customer KV eviction policy for long-doc flows.
- Risk: Burst concurrency >40 will push queueing; recommend autoscale buffer of x1.5 for week-of-launch and steady-state x1.2 thereafter.

I'll update the onboarding Action Grid with the numbers and a recommended node spec + quant profile by 6/8 EOD. Also attaching my quick profiling notes.

Karthik
